pr_title: update scale client to support non-namespaced resources
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind feature

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
Currently, the scale client (`k8s.io/client-go/scale`) doesn't work for non-namespaced resources e.g. cluster-scoped CRDs.
This PR updates the `Scales` function in `ScalesGetter` to provide such support.

issue_context.title: scale client: support non-namespaced resources
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
The scale client (`k8s.io/client-go/scale`) currently works fine with namespaced resources. However, it doesn't work for non-namespaced resources e.g. cluster-scoped CRDs. The current implementation should be extended in order to support non-namespaced resources.

The current `ScalesGetter` interface:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/f020c9159869918c63e0aad56abd01e655e61e78/staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/scale/interfaces.go#L25-L29

/area custom-resources
/sig autoscaling
comments:
I think scale subresource support for CRDs falls more into sig-apimachinery domain. After DirectXMan12 moved on from sig-autoscaling I don't think there is anyone in our sig-autoscaling with knowledge of scale subresource internals. 

/sig api-machinery
The bug report sounds legit. Does the generic scale client need to be changed (I think so), or does https://github.com/kubernetes/dashboard/pull/4195 solve your issue?

No, the dashboard PR doesn't solve this. I discovered this issue while working on that PR so when https://github.com/kubernetes/dashboard/pull/4195 gets merged, it will only work for namespaced CRDs.

I think the generic scale client needs to be updated, maybe by adding another getter to the ScalesGetter interface:

```go
ScalesIfScoped(namespace string, isScoped bool) ScaleInterface
```

/kind bug

review_comments: does this func work if the argument is empty? I.e. the funcs below are just convenience funcs?
